name: NegaBench
summary: Evaluates manipulation under negated instructions, in which a task must be completed while an explicit exclusion is respected, and proposes the NegaAlign framework.
numbers: 10 scenarios, 5 domains; π0.5 2.60%→88.45% in sim, 12.4%→88.8% on real tasks; also GR00T, π0

why.cog: Must respect an exclusion stated in language.
why.xr: Bounded harm; relevant to instruction-based safety constraints.
